title: EU Council and Parliament agree to delay and simplify AI Act rules
summary: A provisional AI omnibus deal pushes standalone high-risk obligations to Dec 2027 and embedded ones to Aug 2028, while adding a ban on nudification and CSAM-generating AI tools.
reason: Binding-rule timetable loosened in the world's main AI regime; partial offset by new prohibition.

title: Cloudflare lays off ~1,100 (about 20%), saying AI made roles obsolete
summary: Cloudflare announced about 1,100 job cuts as it rebuilt processes for the agentic AI era, with CEO Matthew Prince saying many cut roles were 'measurers'.
reason: Large share of workforce cut explicitly attributed to AI.
